text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear overall paragraphing with an intro, body, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is structured into recognizable sections that help the reader follow the argument."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like \"On the other hand\" and \"Otherwise\"","quality":"transitions","description":"The essay uses discourse markers to connect ideas and signal shifts between points."},{"evidence":"sustained discussion of \"obstacles,\" \"opportunities,\" and \"experiences\"","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay develops its response with multiple supporting ideas rather than brief, list-like statements."},{"evidence":"sentences such as \"A good attitude helps people to be more intelligent and to face their problems\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows somewhat better control of complete sentence forms and larger syntactic units."},{"evidence":"longer connected explanations with examples of actors and a mother facing hardship","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay expands points with examples and explanation instead of stopping after a single claim."}]}
